title: «Электроника 6.15М» — Soviet desk/bedside DIGITAL ALARM CLOCK, green ИВЛ1-7/5 VFD, red plastic case (HH:MM, mains-powered, 9V Krona backup)
era: USSR, mid-1980s onward. The 6.15 family ran early-1980s→1990s; the 6.15М variant is dated 1985. Maker: завод «Микрокомпонент», г. Учкекен / завод «Время», г. Усть-Джегута, Ставропольский край (а/я 84) — the same Stavropol plant; one museum page mis-attributes a Minsk «Электроника». Built on К176ИЕ18/К176ИЕ13/К176ИД3 logic + ЗП-1 buzzer; mains transformer Т19-220-50.
identification_note: POSITIVELY IDENTIFIED as «Электроника 6.15М». The user's reference photo (glossy RED rectangular plastic case, smoked clear front filter, green 7-seg VFD reading HH:MM with a colon, the word «электроника» small white at lower-RIGHT of the dark panel, thin mains cable out the back, nightstand-sized) matches the 6.15М front exactly — see images[]: the downloaded front photo shows the identical smoked panel reading «13:13» in green with «электроника» silk-screened lowercase at the lower-right; the rear photo is embossed «ЭЛЕКТРОНИКА 6.15М» + Soviet Quality Mark + «G» export stamp. The user's unit is the RED plastic colour variant (the family was moulded in white/blue/brown/RED). NOT the 2-07 (that is a clock-RADIO), NOT the big 7-06 institutional wall clock (78/140 mm digits, wood case), NOT the 2-11 (smaller grey plastic export alarm, 83×55 mm front).

sources.ivl_datasheet_pdf: ИВЛ1-7/5 factory datasheet (scanned, with dimensioned envelope + single-digit drawings): symbol/digit height 21 mm, digit width 13,67 mm, segment width 1,8 mm; glass envelope length 133 mm, glass height 45 mm (active ~47), overall height with leads 55 mm, thickness 12 mm (glass body 7,5 mm); digits 0–9 in positions 1,2,4,5 and TWO dots (colon) in position 3 («точка К» pin2 / «точка Л» pin10); colour зелёный; mass ≤45 g — https://radio-hobby.org/uploads/datasheets/ivl/ivl1%207.5.pdf
sources.ivl_zapadpribor: ИВЛ1-7/5 dealer/parametric listing — overall '133×47×12 mm', glow colour green, 'used in Электроника-series clocks' — https://zapadpribor.com/ivl1-7-5/
sources.ivl_signalizacia: ИВЛ1-7/5 description — 'индикатор цифровой многоразрядный вакуумный люминесцентный … цифр от 0 до 9 в 1, 2, 4 и 5-м разрядах и двух точек в 3-м разряде'; flat glass body, flexible leads, mass ≤45 g; цвет свечения зелёный; накал 5 В/120±12 мА; анод-сегмент 27 В; яркость 500 кд/м² — https://signalizacia.in.ua/index.files/indikator_vakuumnij_luminescentnij_cifrovoj_mnogorazrjadnij_ivl1_7_5.htm
sources.wiki_soviet_clocks: ru.wikipedia «Электронные часы СССР» — model list; 6.15М is a bedside/desk alarm; cross-references the ИВЛ1-7/5 (used by 4.13, 6.15М) and ИВЛ2-7/5 (used by 12-41) green VFD tubes — https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Электронные_часы_СССР
sources.petrofflab_chasy: Radiotech modding labs «ЧАСЫ ЭЛЕКТРОНИКА» — 6.15 detail: display ИВЛ1-7/5; logic К176ИЕ18/ИЕ13/ИД3; transformer Т19-220-50; case plastic OR wood-veneer (mahogany/beech); FRONT = green plastic light-filter with horizontal embossed stripes and 'электроника 6' text; gold coating on embossing (mainly wood versions); buttons on FRONT for plastic cases, REAR for wood; colour variants incl. RED and green — https://www.petrofflab.ru/p/chasy-electronika.html
sources.habr_teardown: Habr (macloud) «Часы Электроника 6.15М» full teardown — ИВЛ1-7/5 with adjustable brightness; control buttons «Я» (яркость/brightness), «Ч» (часы/hours), «К» (коррекция/correction), «М» (минуты/minutes), «Б» (будильник/alarm-set), toggle «С» (сигнал/sound); power 220 V AC, filament 5 V, anode/grid 27 V; chips К176ИЕ18/ИЕ13/ИД3; downloaded photos show: front smoked panel reading «13:13» green with «электроника» lowercase at lower-right + alarm indicator by the colon; rear embossed «ЭЛЕКТРОНИКА 6.15М» + Знак качества + «G»; a column of 6 round side buttons; round ЗП-1 buzzer grille; grey twin mains lead out the bottom; 9V «Крона» battery bay — https://habr.com/ru/company/macloud/blog/564996/
sources.sovtech_museum: Виртуальный музей советской бытовой техники «Часы Электроника 6.15М» — dated 1985, rectangular plastic housing, darker front panel, «ЭЛЕКТРОНИКА» front branding, HH:MM, ИВЛ display — https://www.sovtech.su/2023/03/20/часы-электроника-6-15м/

case_dimensions.note: Overall case ≈ 195 (W, left-right) × 75 (H, top-bottom of the wide-short front face) × 100 (D, front-to-back). SINGLE marketplace source (ebay_dims_615 '19.5×7.5×10 cm'); the wide-short-deep proportion is confirmed by the front photo (front face aspect ≈ 2.6:1) and by the ИВЛ1-7/5 tube it must house (133 mm wide → case ~195 wide leaves ~31 mm margin each side; tube ~47–55 mm tall → 75 mm face leaves ~10 mm top/bottom). Exact габариты + axis order → needs[].
case_dimensions.src: ebay_dims_615 (195×75×100 mm); proportion cross-checked against ivl_datasheet_pdf tube width 133 mm and the front photo in images[]

vfd_display.type: Многоразрядный вакуумно-люминесцентный индикатор (multi-digit vacuum-fluorescent display), flat glass envelope, flexible leads
vfd_display.glow_colour: Green (зелёный / 'изумрудное свечение' emerald), 7-segment phosphor, ~500 cd/m² nominal per digit
vfd_display.digit_positions: 4 numeric digits in positions 1,2,4,5 + a fixed colon (two dots, «точка К» upper / «точка Л» lower) in the central position 3 → reads HH:MM
vfd_display.src: ivl_datasheet_pdf (envelope 133×45/55×12, 7,5 mm glass, 4 digits + colon, green, ≤45 g) + ivl_zapadpribor ('133×47×12 mm', green) + ivl_signalizacia (positions 1,2,4,5 + two dots in 3, green); used-in-6.15М confirmed by habr_teardown + wiki_soviet_clocks

digit_geometry.note: Per-symbol geometry straight off the ИВЛ1-7/5 datasheet drawing: digit cell 21 mm tall × 13,67 mm wide, segment bar 1,8 mm, centre-to-centre digit pitch ≈18,3 mm, the central colon gap (Ø4 hole region) ≈16 mm. These ARE the green characters the player reads as HH:MM.
digit_geometry.src: ivl_datasheet_pdf (single-digit detail 21 × 13,67, segment 1,8; spacing 18,3 / colon 16 off the envelope drawing)

front_filter.material: Translucent injection-moulded acrylic/polystyrene light filter — smoked dark grey-to-near-black when unlit (some 6.15 variants use a green-tinted filter); high gloss; reads as a flat black panel that the green digits glow through
front_filter.coverage: Wraps/insets the full front face inside the case rim; the case plastic frames it on top/bottom/sides
front_filter.embossing: Some variants carry horizontal embossed stripes flanking the window and an embossed 'электроника 6' (gold-filled on wood-cased versions); the photographed plastic unit instead has a clean smoked panel
front_filter.src: petrofflab_chasy (green light-filter, horizontal embossed stripes, 'электроника 6', gold embossing on wood) + habr_teardown front photo (smoked panel, digits glow through) — see images[]

markings.front_logo: «электроника» — lowercase Cyrillic, small, WHITE silk-screen, at the LOWER-RIGHT of the dark front panel (below and right of the digits)
markings.alarm_indicator: A small alarm/'set' indicator (bell-like icon / extra dot) sits adjacent to the colon, centre, just above/left of it — an alarm-on tell (the user's 'tiny separate dot low-center'); distinct from the two colon dots
markings.rear_embossing: «ЭЛЕКТРОНИКА 6.15М» embossed on the rear/bottom housing, alongside the Soviet State Quality Mark (Знак качества, pentagon-К) and an export «G» stamp
markings.src: habr_teardown photos (front lowercase «электроника» lower-right; rear «ЭЛЕКТРОНИКА 6.15М» + Знак качества + «G») — both downloaded into images[]; alarm indicator visible in the front photo

buttons.meaning: С = сигнал/alarm-sound toggle, Я = яркость/brightness, К = коррекция/correction, Б = будильник/alarm-set, Ч = часы/hours, М = минуты/minutes
buttons.type: Small round push-buttons in a single vertical column
buttons.location: On the LEFT side wall of the photographed unit (petrofflab notes plastic-case variants can carry them on the FRONT, wood-case variants on the REAR)
buttons.src: habr_teardown (6 buttons, column, labels С/Я/К/Б/Ч/М visible in the rear photo) + petrofflab_chasy (front-vs-rear placement by case type)

rear_and_power.mains_cable: Thin grey two-wire (twin-lead) mains flex exiting the BOTTOM-centre of the rear housing
rear_and_power.power: 220 V AC mains via transformer Т19-220-50 → 5 V filament + 27 V anode/grid; backup 9 V «Крона» battery in a rear bay keeps time on outage
rear_and_power.buzzer: Round piezo/dynamic alarm buzzer ЗП-1 behind a perforated grille on the rear-left
rear_and_power.src: habr_teardown (grey twin mains lead bottom-centre, 220/5/27 V, ЗП-1, 9V Крона bay) + petrofflab_chasy (Т19-220-50) + technochas_615i (mains + Крона backup)

case_material.shell: Glossy injection-moulded thermoplastic (polystyrene/ABS), opaque RED for the user's unit (family moulded white/blue/brown/red); wide-short-deep rectangular box
case_material.base: Stands on a small low base/foot moulded under the front (the front photo sits the panel on a short pedestal/feet)
case_material.src: ebay_red_615a + ebay_red_615b (red plastic 6.15) + colors_restoration + petrofflab_chasy (plastic vs wood, colour list); base/foot from images[] front photo

feature_inventory.feature: Red glossy injection-moulded plastic case, wide-short-deep rectangular box on a small base/foot (≈195×75×100 mm)
Smoked/green translucent acrylic front light-filter wrapping the full front face, reading flat black when unlit; green digits glow through it
Green ИВЛ1-7/5 vacuum-fluorescent tube — 4 seven-segment digits + a fixed central colon (two dots) → HH:MM; digit cell 21×13,67 mm, segment 1,8 mm; tube envelope 133×47×12 mm
Colon = two dots (точка К upper / точка Л lower) in the central 3rd position between hours and minutes
Small alarm/'set' indicator (bell icon / extra dot) beside the colon — alarm-on tell, distinct from the colon dots
«электроника» logo — lowercase white silk-screen at the LOWER-RIGHT of the dark front panel
Six round push-buttons in a vertical column, labels С/Я/К/Б/Ч/М (sound/brightness/correction/alarm/hours/minutes), on the side (plastic variants may put them on the front)
Rear housing embossed «ЭЛЕКТРОНИКА 6.15М» + Soviet Quality Mark (Знак качества) + export «G» stamp
Thin grey two-wire mains cable exiting the bottom-centre of the rear; 220 V AC (transformer Т19-220-50, 5 V filament / 27 V anode-grid)
9 V «Крона» backup battery bay in the rear; round ЗП-1 alarm buzzer behind a perforated grille rear-left
Internal logic К176ИЕ18 / К176ИЕ13 / К176ИД3 (flavour/era only, not modelled)

images.shows: 6.15М FRONT — wide smoked-black glossy panel, green VFD reading «13:13» (HH:MM + colon), small alarm indicator left of the colon, «электроника» lowercase white silk-screen at the LOWER-RIGHT, mains cable from top/rear, on a low base. The user's red unit is this exact face in a red case.

Rear/inside housing — embossed «ЭЛЕКТРОНИКА 6.15М» + Soviet Quality Mark + «G»; a column of 6 round side buttons labelled С/Я/К/Б/Ч/М; round ЗП-1 buzzer grille; 9V Krona battery bay (right, yellow leads); grey twin mains lead out the bottom-centre
The filter removed — the bare green ИВЛ1-7/5 VFD on its PCB reading «13:13», confirming the 4-digit + colon HH:MM green display and the flat glass envelope
Main PCB — К176ИД3 / К176ИЕ18 chips, ЗП-1 buzzer, transformer, Krona clip (flavour/era confirmation only)
eBay «ELEKTRONIKA 6.15 RED COLOR» — landing page confirming the RED plastic variant (also https://www.ebay.com/itm/394480970160)
